summary: ML engineer and published researcher (AAAI 2026) completing an M.S. in Computer Science at Arizona State (May 2027). I build models and the production software around them: LLM evaluation tooling, explainable NLP and forecasting.

bullets: Improved forecast accuracy by 18% over the prior method (82% overall) by building and validating time-series models in Python on a 40K+ record retail customer-trajectory dataset.
Reduced the mean daily error of digital ad-revenue forecasts to $142 by identifying 3 hidden patterns in user-behavior data, enabling 15% more efficient marketing budget allocation.

Co-developed X-MuTeST, explainable hate-speech detection for English, Hindi and Telugu on a 16,830-post benchmark with word-level human rationales, reaching 88.8%, 87.5% and 86.0% accuracy; published at AAAI 2026.

Trained MuRIL and XLM-R with two-stage attention supervision (human rationales, then an n-gram perturbation probe merged with LLaMA 3.1 rationales); evaluated explanations with Token-F1, IOU-F1, comprehensiveness and sufficiency.
Reduced model inference latency by 20% through iterative pipeline improvements and documented model design and deployment in technical reports.
Built responsive web pages and a Node.js / EJS application.
